technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with price above all major MAs and positive ADX/OBV, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 81, Stoch 92) with bearish stochastic cross and non-rising RSI signal exhaustion risk; entry quality compromised by lack of fresh momentum confirmation and multiple overbought warnings.

fundamental.summary: NI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 30 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; Fear index (38) presents mild contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (390.88), flat yield curve, and 30-day earnings event create a highly unfavourable macro backdrop for NI utilities trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with positive ADX/DI and OBV momentum structure suggests intact uptrend mechanics despite overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought readings (RSI 81, Stoch 92 with bearish cross), non-rising RSI divergence, crisis VIX backdrop, 30-day earnings risk, and zero fundamental support create exhaustion setup with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Not applicable — technical structure shows intact uptrend but extreme overbought exhaustion (RSI 81, Stoch 92 bearish cross) with zero fundamental support and crisis macro backdrop eliminate entry conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 30 days combined with crisis VIX (390.88) and overbought technical exhaustion creates high probability of sharp mean reversion into existing position.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to hold existing position: atr_trail_1x with tight stops given macro risk.
